content:
maria: Heads-up — we landed additional audit events for KMS key operations and RBAC changes in staging. Need a quick sync on validation for customer SDKs and the external-facing changelog before we cut release.

ajay: Saw the events. Quick Q: do SDKs need schema bumps? Seems we added `kms.key_material_change` and `rbac.role_assignment.v2` event types.

kelly: Yes, SDK JSON schema needs the new enum values. Also added `actor.identity_source` to tie events to customer IdP vs service principal.

ethan: Example event we emit now — please validate against SDK parsers:```json
{
  "event_type": "kms.key_material_change",
  "ts": "2026-03-12T18:12:03Z",
  "resource": { "type": "kms_key", "id": "key-01A3" },
  "actor": { "id": "svc-redwood-agent", "identity_source": "service-account" },
  "details": { "rotation_reason": "scheduled", "old_wrapped_key": null }
}```

natalie: SDKs currently reject unknown event_type enums. We should either publish a minor version bump with relaxed enum handling or ship a patch to whitelist these new types.

sam: For customer-facing validation: recommend a two-step approach — (1) publish detailed schema + sample events in docs, (2) provide a compatibility test script customers can run (curl -> validate).

maria: Agreed. Also need to call out RBAC changes that affect audit coverage: role assignment events now include `actor.previous_roles` and `actor.new_roles`. That can be sensitive; we must ensure redaction guidance is in docs.

kelly: On redaction — we added `sensitive_fields` metadata at event level to flag what SHOULD be redacted when exporting. Example snippet:```json
{ "event_type": "rbac.role_assignment.v2", "sensitive_fields": ["actor.email"], "details": { "previous_roles": ["viewer"], "new_roles": ["admin"] } }```

ethan: sec-bot flagged a potential vuln: if audit export includes `old_wrapped_key` non-null, that could leak key material. I added a check in runtime to null that field before export.

sec-bot: automated-check: audit-exporter: found 1 rule violation in staging — field `details.old_wrapped_key` present in 1/200 events. Blocked for export until sanitized.

ajay: Good catch. We also need to validate that KMS integration logs include KMS key IDs but never key material. Tests should assert `old_wrapped_key == null` for public exports.

maria: Proposal for public changelog blurb (short):

"Audit log updates: Added expanded KMS and RBAC event coverage. New audit fields (`actor.identity_source`, `sensitive_fields`) improve traceability and allow better redaction controls. SDKs: please upgrade to vX.Y for schema updates. See docs for migration steps and validation script."

natalie: Suggest we soften SDK statement — not everyone can upgrade immediately. Maybe: "SDKs: updated schemas are available; clients should verify compatibility using the provided validation script. We will support old schemas for 30 days."

sam: For customer comms we also need a short migration example for Python and JS showing how to ignore unknown event types. E.g. Python:```python
from redwood_sdk import AuditEvent
# allow unknown enums
event = AuditEvent.parse_raw(payload, allow_population_by_field_name=True)
# or fallback-safe parsing
```

kelly: Docs action items: add sample events, update schema.json, publish compatibility test script, add migration snippets, add redaction best-practices section. I can take docs updates if someone reviews.

maria: Who owns the SDK bump? ajay or engineering SDK team?

ajay: I'll coordinate with SDK team. Plan: publish new minor that accepts new enums and exposes `sensitive_fields` in parsed object.

ethan: Rollout plan idea:
- deploy audit producer change to staging (done)
- run exporter sanitization tests (24h)
- publish docs + validation script (T+2d)
- release SDK minor + optional compatibility flag (T+3d)
- communicate to customers (email + console banner) and support 30-day overlap

maria: Timeline works. Can someone draft the console banner blurb? Keep it short.

natalie: Draft banner: "Audit logs: improved KMS & RBAC coverage. Please validate integrations with our schema test. See documentation -> Security -> Audit logs."

sam: I'll prepare the compatibility test script and a quick-run README.

kelly: Docs PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4521 (WIP) — ping me for review.

sec-bot: deploy-bot: staging-audit-producer v1.12 deployed at 2026-03-12T19:04:23Z by ci-pipeline.

ajay: One more operational note: update retention policy mapping in docs — `sensitive_fields` should be excluded from long-term exports by default.

maria: Great. Action owners: kelly -> docs PR, ajay -> SDK release coord, sam -> validation script, ethan -> exporter sanitization tests, natalie -> customer comms + banner. I'll follow up with a short email to accounts owners once docs are live. :thumbsup:

kelly: Will do.

sam: ETA on script: EOD tomorrow.

ethan: Tests running now, will post results.

maria: Thanks everyone. If sec-bot blocks on staging again, we pause export and notify compliance.

sec-bot: monitoring: exporter-sanitization: passing (0 violations) at 2026-03-13T02:11:06Z

maria: Marking thread for follow-up after SDK release.
